gap_description: Few or none of the charted records compare otherwise equivalent manual and automated recovery conditions under the same controlled faults and workload.
current_evidence_basis: Technical tool evaluations and operational studies use heterogeneous baselines; no direct controlled recovery comparison is charted.
proposed_response: Use a preregistered or versioned trial manifest with fixed faults, workload, software version, detection rule and reset procedure.
open_dependency: Retrieve pending records and complete authenticated searches

gap_description: Direct evidence about workload, trust, understanding and decision rationale is sparse and not paired with the technical automation studies.
current_evidence_basis: P23, P26 and P27 provide practice evidence but not controlled automation-effect measures.
proposed_response: Define a separate participant-facing protocol, validated measures and qualitative decision-rationale collection; obtain ethics approval before claims.

gap_description: Detection, diagnosis, recovery, instability and failure-impact outcomes are defined differently across studies.
current_evidence_basis: P04, P06, P10, P12, P13, P14, P15, P16, P17, P18 and P19 report non-equivalent outcomes.
proposed_response: Freeze an event contract and derive metrics from immutable technical events before trials.

gap_description: Proprietary incident data and incomplete environment/configuration reporting constrain independent replication.
current_evidence_basis: Industrial operational studies and some model deployments rely on private data or configuration.
proposed_response: Use replayable synthetic workload, public schemas, immutable manifests, versioned configuration and provenance records.

gap_description: Much of the charted evidence concerns adjacent cloud operations, microservices or incident management rather than controlled continuous-delivery recovery.
current_evidence_basis: P04, P06, P10, P12, P13, P14, P15, P16, P17, P18, P19 and P23 are adjacent or operational contexts; P27 is a case study.
proposed_response: Retain the continuous-delivery boundary in the search strategy and justify transfer from adjacent contexts explicitly.
open_dependency: Authenticated database searches and pending records

gap_description: Prototype, industrial and high-reliability embedded contexts differ in ways that may affect mechanism and outcome transfer.
current_evidence_basis: P13, P19 and P27 illustrate materially different systems and domains.
proposed_response: Use OrderFlow only as a bounded experimental system and state external-validity limits; do not generalise from frequency.
open_dependency: Phase 2 technology decision and Phase 3 validation

gap_description: The current appraisals need page, section, table or figure locators before they can support final proposal wording.
proposed_response: Complete a source-location transcription pass and attach locators to every synthesis claim used in the proposal.
